description_en: Removes nodes from a cluster when the nodes are no longer needed. The ReleaseNode parameter specifies whether to release the underlying Edge Node Service (ENS) compute instances. Default value: false. If the node to be removed is in the failed state, this parameter does not take effect and the corresponding compute instance is released by default. For ENS compute instances that you manually connect to the cluster by using the script obtained from the DescribeAttachScript operation, this parameter does not take effect and the corresponding compute instances are not released by default
description_zh:
当您不再需要集群节点继续工作时，可以调用DeleteClusterNodes接口将集群中的节点移出集群。 ReleaseNode参数用于控制是否释放底层ENS计算实例，默认为false。
如果需要删除的node为failed状态，该参数不生效，默认释放对应计算实例。
对于您通过 DescribeAttachScript 接口获取脚本后，自行接入的ENS计算实例，该参数不生效，默认不释放对应计算实例
name: DeleteClusterNodes

fields.help_en: The information about the nodes to be removed
fields.name: nodes

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to release the ENS instance where the node resides. Default value: true
parameters.help_zh: 是否释放Node所在ens实例，默认为true
parameters.name: release_node
